goal: Iske baad aap struct members ko read, print aur un se calculate kar sakte hain, do structs ko member ba member compare kar sakte hain, struct ke andar struct use kar sakte hain, aur struct ke andar array rakh sakte hain.
warmup: Ek dukandaar ke paas bill hota hai jis mein item ka naam, price aur quantity hoti hai. Total nikalne ke liye woh bill par price aur quantity ko multiply karta hai. Yeh check karne ke liye ke do bills ek jaise hain, woh item, price aur quantity ek ek kar ke compare karta hai, poore kaghaz ko ghoor kar nahi. Struct members bhi aise hi kaam karte hain: har member ko aam variable ki tarah use kiya jata hai.
definition: Struct ka har data member apni type ke aam variable ki tarah chalta hai. double member ko arithmetic mein, int member ko comparison mein, aur string member ko cin ke saath use kiya ja sakta hai. Poore struct variable ke saath sirf yeh cheezein seedhi nahi ho sakti: cin >> s, cout << s aur s1 == s2. Member ba member kaam karein. Poore struct ke saath ek cheez ho sakti hai: usay assign karna, s2 = s1. Struct ke andar doosra struct (nested structure) ya array bhi ho sakta hai.
howItWorks: Reading aur printing: cin >> s1.id; aur cout << s1.name; Har member ko alag se treat kiya jata hai. Arithmetic: s1.price * s1.qty, ya s1.qty = s1.qty + 2; member bas ek variable hai jis ka naam dot wala hai. Do structs ko compare karna: s1 == s2 compile error deta hai, kyunke C++ ko nahi pata ke aap ki type ke liye 'equal' ka kya matlab hona chahiye. Jo members aap ke kaam ke hain unhein && se jor kar compare karein: s1.id == s2.id && s1.name == s2.name. Nested structures: agar Student ka ek member birth hai jis ki type Date hai, to saal tak DO dots se pohanchte hain: s1.birth.year. Dots ko baayen se daayen parhein: s1, phir uska birth, phir uska year. Struct ke andar arrays: struct ek array rakh sakta hai, maslan int marks[3];. Aap ek mark tak r.marks[i] se pohanchte hain, aur us par aam tarah loop chala sakte hain. Sab ko jor kar: exam program ek struct mein naam aur teen marks parhta hai, average aur grade nikalta hai, aur unhein usi struct mein wapas rakh deta hai. Ek student ki har cheez ek hi variable ke andar rehti hai, aur koi function ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Pehla trace copy r2 = r1 dikhata hai. Doosra nested struct ka comparison dikhata hai. Teesra loop ke andar array member dikhata hai.
